# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title:** MetricGuard: Trustworthy AI Analytics on IBM Db2
- **Project Slug (must match folder name):** `submissions/metricguard/`
- **Short Description (1–3 sentences):** Natural-language analytics on IBM Db2 where the model only plans. Meta Muse Spark 1.3 (via LangChain) returns a typed plan; deterministic code compiles parameterized SQL from hash-locked Db2 metric definitions, runs it as a SELECT-only account, reconciles the numbers and writes an append-only Db2 audit record.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** A text-to-SQL query can run without error and still report the wrong business number. Example from the seeded dataset: a plausible orders ⨝ items ⨝ refunds join reports $781,330.86 of H1 2026 gross revenue; the governed value is $667,622.16. Audience: analysts and data teams that need to know which definition, which SQL and which reconciliation stand behind a number.

## 2. Team Information

- **Team Name:** MetricGuard (Solo)
- **Team Members:**

| Full Name | GitHub Username | Email / Role |
|---|---|---|
| Jaehyup Shin | @shin0343 | jshin4@scu.edu / Solo developer (Db2, backend, AI planner, frontend) |

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** Db2 Community Edition 12.1.5.0 on Docker (`icr.io/db2_community/db2`), run on Apple Silicon through Colima with QEMU.
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution:** Db2 holds the business tables (orders, order lines, products, refunds), the approved metric definitions with SHA-256 hashes, and the append-only audit log. Every answer is a parameterized Db2 query executed by a SELECT-only account; reconciliation runs independent control queries in Db2; audit rows are written by a separate INSERT-plus-SELECT account.
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:** `ibm_db` 3.3.0 from FastAPI. LangChain is used only for the Meta model call.
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed:** `ORDERS` (2,924), `ORDER_ITEMS` (6,540), `PRODUCTS` (40), `REFUNDS` (1,032), `METRIC_DEFINITIONS` (6), `QUERY_AUDIT_LOG`; CHECK and composite foreign-key constraints, 11 indexes, DECIMAL arithmetic, CTEs.
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration:** `cd submissions/metricguard/src && make setup colima-up db-up db-reader db-audit-user db-init db-verify`. `make db-verify` writes `src/evidence/DB2_VERIFICATION.md` and exits non-zero on any failure (7 golden queries vs an independent oracle, 4 naive-SQL traps, 15 reconciliations, privilege checks with Db2 rejecting writes, SQLSTATE 42501). Then `make api` and open the UI, see the README.

## 4. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage

- **Programming Languages:** Python 3.12, TypeScript, SQL
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** FastAPI, Pydantic, LangChain, Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS, Recharts
- **AI / LLM Framework (if applicable):** LangChain (`ChatOpenAI` with strict structured output)
- **Model Provider & Model Name (if applicable):** Meta Model API, `muse-spark-1.3` (`reasoning_effort=low`)
- **Where AI/LLM is Applied in the Workflow:** Only to turn the question into a typed `PlannerOutput` (metrics, dimensions, filters, dates, sort, limit). It never writes SQL; validation, compilation, execution, verification and audit are deterministic code and Db2. A rule-based demo planner exists, is always labelled, and is never used as a silent fallback.

## 5. Demonstration & Links

- **Live Demo URL (if hosted):** not hosted (local demo)
- **Demo Video (YouTube / Loom / Drive):** https://youtu.be/8SpNxsvE32c. 2:33; real screen recording with live Db2 and Meta calls; narration is a synthetic clone of the author's voice.
- **External Source Repo (if hosted separately):** none
- **Presentation / Slides URL (optional):** none

## 6. Submission Verification Checklist

- [x] **Folder Structure:** My submission is placed in a single new directory under `submissions/<project-slug>/` copied from `submissions/_template/`.
- [x] **Naming Conventions:** The `<project-slug>` uses lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, matching the branch name and PR title.
- [x] **Complete Documentation:** Both `submissions/<project-slug>/README.md` and `submissions/<project-slug>/architecture.md` are completely filled out without unfilled placeholder markers.
- [x] **Metadata File:** `submissions/<project-slug>/submission.json` is completed and valid JSON.
- [x] **No Secrets or Credentials:** No API keys, passwords, private tokens, or connection strings with real credentials are committed. `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
- [x] **Tested Setup Instructions:** Setup and run instructions were tested from a clean copy of the package with a fresh virtualenv and `node_modules` (same Apple Silicon Mac; not a second machine).
- [x] **License Declared:** Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`).
- [x] **Code of Conduct:** *(tick this yourself when you open the PR; it is your attestation)*
- [x] **Scope Isolation:** This PR only adds files inside `submissions/metricguard/` and does not touch root files or other submissions.
- [x] **Google Form Submission:** I understand that opening this PR is step 1, and I will submit this PR URL into the official Google Form.

## 7. Additional Notes for Reviewers & Judges

- **30-second tour:** `README.md` opens with the join-multiplication example, then the Db2 integration table. Screenshots are in `docs/screenshots/`.
- **Reproduce the evidence without an API key:** `make test` (156 pass, no database), `make db-verify` (needs the Db2 container). The AI planner needs a Meta Model API key; without one, set `AI_PROVIDER=demo` (labelled "Demo planner", no AI).
- **Layout:** the code is under `src/` and mirrors the development layout so `make` works from there. Tests are in `src/backend/tests/` and `src/frontend/tests/`; `tests/README.md` explains.
- **Apple Silicon:** Db2 runs under QEMU, not Rosetta (Rosetta breaks the image's login shells); a documented post-setup fix restores a file that fenced routines need.
- **Honest limits:** the 37-case live Meta benchmark is a smoke test, not an accuracy rate; `VERIFIED` does not certify the underlying data; an intermittent audit-history 503 was seen intermittently in development and not reproduced; tested on one machine. Details in the README and `architecture.md`.
- **AI disclosure:** built with AI coding assistance (Claude Code); the demo narration is synthetic.
